# Dyness Powerbrick Pro 14.3 kWh BMS Balancing and Charge-Control Behaviour

> Experimental Dyness Powerbrick Pro 14.3 kWh BMS behaviour for battery software 2.50-71.10.11, authored by Heiko Gerdes (hgerdes@tehnosys.ro).

Canonical page: https://elokfu.github.io/dyness-bms-behaviour/
PDF report: https://elokfu.github.io/dyness-bms-behaviour/assets/Dyness_BMS_Balancing_Algorithm_Charge_Control_Firmware_2.50-71.10.11.pdf
DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21860970
License: CC BY 4.0 (author confirmed)

## Key facts
- Pack: 16 physical cells. Cells 1-15 direct telemetry; cell 16 reconstructed from pack voltage minus cells 1-15.
- Battery type tested: Dyness Powerbrick Pro 14.3 kWh.
- Balancer enable: Ibat >= 1.5 A; working timing hypothesis 30 s.
- Balancer disable: Ibat <= 1.4 A; working timing hypothesis 30 s.
- Individual resistor: Vcell - Vmin >= 30 mV.
- Full detection: Vmax >= 3.5 V -> SOC 100 %, CCL 0 A, Charge Enabled false.
- Charge MOSFET remains on at the 3.5 V full threshold.
- Balancing can continue between 3.5 and 3.6 V if balancing conditions are fulfilled.
- Charge MOSFET off: Vmax >= 3.6 V.
- Charge MOSFET closes again after cutoff when discharge is detected; no independent Vmax recovery threshold is established.
- CCL recovery: SOC 100 % -> 99 % -> CCL 56 A, Charge Enabled true.
- No explicit passive-balancing flag identified in decoded status bytes.

The 30-second qualification is an engineering hypothesis; other listed thresholds are reported as nominal observed values under the report disclaimer.
